echam.routines: mo_ham_dust.f90:685-747 (verbatim-extracted, mo_ham_dust.f90::bgc_read_annual_fields's k_dust_easo and ndust=5 MSG-source-override block): the ONLY new arithmetic jax-gcm#1017's ndust=5 preset adds. This block is wind- and soil-moisture-INDEPENDENT (it runs once at annual-field read time on mat_s1..mat_s17/mat_psrc/mat_msg, before any time-stepping), so a representative set of soil-mixture/dust_msg combinations is the complete input space -- wind speed and soil moisture do not enter it at all. They DO enter the downstream saltation/threshold-velocity chain (MB95 (5)-(7)/(15)/(28)/(33)), which ndust=5 shares bit-for-bit with the already-ported, already-tested ndust=4 path (dust_test.py's ThresholdVelocityTest/RedistributionTest/SingleClassFluxTest, hand-derived from the same Fortran constants) and is therefore NOT re-validated by this harness.

checks.note: Exact (0.0) only with JAX x64 enabled (jax.config.update('jax_enable_x64', True)); jcm's float32 default otherwise introduces ~1e-8 relative rounding noise against the Fortran's REAL(dp), which is a dtype artifact, not a logic difference -- confirmed by re-running compare.py with x64 off and seeing the same ~1e-8 gap vanish at x64.

cells.coverage: dust_msg in {0 (inactive), 0.005 (active-but-not-strong, 0 < msg < 0.01), 0.01 (the ndust=5 'strong' boundary, inclusive), 0.02 (strong)}, soil mixtures spanning a pure-Zobler-type-2 Saharan cell, a non-Saharan Zobler mix (type3+type6), and an East-Asian cell (type15) both with and without an active MSG override -- the regimes jax-gcm#1017's task asked for (0, between 0 and 0.01, >= 0.01, Saharan and non-Saharan) plus the k_dust_easo x ndust=5 interaction and the 0.01 boundary itself.
